prompt: I want 50 meetings a month. My market is about 4000 companies total and I'm getting a 3% reply rate.

assertions.name: detects-impossible
assertions.check: Identifies that the goal exceeds the addressable market

assertions.name: sends-upstream
assertions.check: Recommends fixing offer/segment/goal rather than building the list anyway

assertions.name: does-not-bury-it
assertions.check: Leads with the blocker rather than presenting a tidy table first
